description: Search public product variants by query, compound, format, brand, inStockOnly and inclusive single-unit AED price bounds. Results rank exact matches first and include strength, volume, storage guidance and batch-report evidence with unknowns explicit. For Research Use Only. This research-use-only catalogue is for buyers 21+ years of age and is supplied for research purposes only. Not for human or veterinary use. Return exact id values to the basket tools; sku, name and URL are not basket IDs. No personal information required.

brand.description: Exact catalogue brand name, case-insensitive, e.g. ProPeptide.

compound.description: Exact compound name, ID or documented alias, e.g. BPC-157 or bpc157. Includes blends containing that compound.

format.description: Product format. vial includes vial kits; kit amounts remain explicit in strength.label.

inStockOnly.description: Return only currently orderable, in-stock variants. Defaults to false.

maxPriceAed.description: Inclusive maximum single-unit AED price, before discounts/delivery.

minPriceAed.description: Inclusive minimum single-unit AED price, before discounts/delivery.

offset.description: Start at 0 or use nextOffset. Keep filters unchanged across pages.

query.description: Optional product text or compound alias. Exact IDs/names rank first. Never include personal information.

name: search_products
